releases.summary: Component-level tagging for granular AWS cost tracking and infrastructure organization
highlights: New componentTagNames array in stackTags configuration enables component-level resource identification
Component tags applied to all AWS infrastructure: Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, Fargate, KMS, OpenSearch, Bedrock inference profiles
Granular cost analysis in AWS Cost Explorer - see costs for specific Lambda functions, DynamoDB tables, or AI models within each service
Helper method applyComponentTags() in custom-stack-defs.ts for easy tagging of custom infrastructure
Tag environment variable support for CloudFormation custom resources with new utility functions
500-byte validation limit for tag environment variables prevents deployment failures
Fixed inference profile tag deduplication bug that caused Bedrock profile creation failures
Added timestamp forcing to custom resources ensuring updates apply on every deployment
New TypeScript property: PikaConfig.stackTags.componentTagNames with @since 0.14.0 annotation
Enhanced AWS CDK deployment documentation with Component Tags for Cost Tracking section

releases.summary: Inference profile cost tracking, AWS resource tagging, and markdown rendering utilities
highlights: Automatic creation of named inference profiles for granular AI model cost tracking in AWS Cost Explorer
Inference profiles enable per-model cost analysis (Claude 4 Sonnet, Claude 4.5 Haiku, Claude 4.5 Sonnet)
Comprehensive AWS resource tagging system with dynamic placeholders ({stage}, {accountId}, {region}, etc.)
New stackTags configuration in pika-config.ts with common, pikaServiceTags, and pikaChatTags categories
Tags applied to all AWS resources including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, and inference profiles
Markdown renderer factory with caching for efficient HTML conversion in web components
New appState.convertMarkdownToHtml() method for markdown rendering in custom components
Lambda custom resource utilities for improved maintainability across CloudFormation custom resources
New documentation: Track AI Model Costs guide, AWS Resource Tags guide, Inference Profile Names reference
New TypeScript interfaces with @since 0.13.0: PikaConfig.stackTags, MarkdownRendererConfig, IAppState.convertMarkdownToHtml()
